match: approve (all|every|each)( of)?( the| my)?( open| pending)? expenses?

output.text: I can't approve expenses for you, and Weft has no bulk approval: each expense gets its own decision from a person. I can walk you through them one at a time instead. Open Expenses and start with the first item in Needs review; for each one I will explain its policy checks and the suggested decision, and you decide that item before we move to the next.
